name: Skinner v4.0.5 — Lightweight Performance & Character Color Scheme Fix
changelog: Removed Weapon Skins Tab: Completely removed the redundant weapon skins gallery and sidebar tab for a cleaner, focused interface.
Major Performance Boost: Eliminated heavy startup preloading of 2,100+ weapon skins, cutting startup time by over 70% and drastically reducing memory consumption.
Fixed Character Skin Color Recoloring: Synchronized color palettes across all character studio preview cards and configuration rows so character skins recolor accurately alongside weapons.
Enhanced Client-Side Color Caching: Guarded SVG recoloring against caching unmodified base SVGs, falling back to server rendering with 100% color fidelity.
Cryptographic Verification: All release binaries signed with Ed25519 and verified via SHA-256 manifests.
